emma (Support): Heads up — ACME PROD reporting p99 latency spikes on /v1/generate since 10:30 UTC, started after deploy. Customers seeing 504s and timeouts. Request IDs: rq_abc123, rq_def456. Can oncall pick this up?
jamal (Oncall): I'll take it. What's the scale? QPS and region?
emma (Support): ~20 qps from ACME, 95% from eu-west-1, they report p99 ~4.5s (was ~0.6s). No auth or billing errors. Logs attached: `504 gateway_timeout` + `upstream_deadline`.
kevin (SRE): Pulled traces — root cause looks like GPU host OOM / evictions, high KV cache misses. Host gpu-03 saturated on seq_len>1024. Repro curl to hit same pattern: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"<long prompt>"}'```
jamal (Oncall): Oncall steps: 1) apply per-customer throttling to 10rps 2) enable fallback to redwood-3b for ACME 3) add short-term circuit-breaker if p99>2.5s for 5m. I'll run.
jamal (Oncall): /ops/route throttle --customer acme --qps 10 —success
deploy-bot: route update applied by jamal at 2024-05-12T10:42:12Z
dan (Runtime): I'm enabling model fallback — switching ACME to redwood-3b in us-west-2 as fallback. Patching routing policy now.
dan (Runtime): /ops/route set-fallback --customer acme --model redwood-3b --region us-west-2 —done
kevin (SRE): Also increased KV cache size on gpu-03 host and restarted inference-worker there. Watch for improved hit rate. Metrics show GPU utilization falling from 98% → 72%.
emma (Support): ACME confirms latency improving to p99 ~0.9s, no 504s now. They ask if this will recur.
kevin (SRE): Follow-up mitigation: add SLO guardrail — automatic circuit-breaker if p99>2s for 3m, plus auto-fallback to a quantized variant for long prompts. I'll file a change.
kevin (SRE): created ticket INF-7834 to add auto-guardrail and model quantization fallback for long prompts.
lina (Customer Success): Noted — I'll let ACME know we implemented temporary throttling + fallback and will follow up tomorrow with ETA on permanent fix.
jamal (Oncall): Closing handoff. tagging @customer-success to confirm ACME happy. :thumbsup:
